names.plain: Nerve in front of the ear

gloss: A branch of the jaw nerve (trigeminal) that gives feeling to the skin in front of the ear and temple and carries the signal that makes the parotid produce saliva.
role: A nerve in front of the ear, the auriculotemporal nerve, gives feeling to the temple skin and carries the signal that makes the parotid gland produce saliva.
matters: After injury, the nerve fibres that should make saliva can grow into the sweat glands of the skin, so that eating makes the skin over the gland sweat.
